aka.zh: X 干线（1986—1988 年规划名称）

tagline.en: The airport-era expressway from Sai Ying Pun to Yuen Long, with a private tunnel at each end
tagline.zh: 机场核心计划时代的快速公路，由西营盘通往元朗，两端各有一条私营隧道

start.en: Connaught Road West (Route 4) at Sai Ying Pun, on Hong Kong Island
start.zh: 香港岛西营盘干诺道西（4号干线）

end.en: Route 9 at Au Tau, near Pok Oi Hospital in Yuen Long
end.zh: 元朗凹头，近博爱医院，接 9号干线

en: Route 3 is about 27 km of expressway from the western end of Hong Kong Island to Yuen Long in the north-west New Territories. It crosses the harbour in the Western Harbour Crossing, runs on viaduct up the West Kowloon reclamation, crosses to Tsing Yi on the Rambler Channel Bridge and through the Cheung Tsing Tunnel, then turns north over the Ting Kau Bridge and through the Tai Lam Tunnel to the Tsing Long Highway and Kam Tin.

It was built in the 1990s as part of the Airport Core Programme, partly to feed the new airport at Chek Lap Kok through the Tsing Yi interchange with Route 8, and partly to relieve the north-west's main roads, Tuen Mun Road above all, which were expected to be saturated by the mid-1990s. The busiest point is the Cheung Tsing Highway near the north-western Tsing Yi interchange, where airport, container-port and north-west traffic share the road.
zh: 3号干线全长约 27 公里，为快速公路，由港岛西端通往新界西北的元朗。它经西区海底隧道过海，沿西九龙填海区高架北上，经长青桥跨越蓝巴勒海峡到青衣并穿过长青隧道，再转北经汀九桥及大榄隧道，接青朗公路至锦田。
它于 1990 年代作为机场核心计划的一部分兴建：一方面经青衣与 8号干线的交汇处通往赤鱲角新机场，另一方面为预计于 1990 年代中饱和的新界西主要道路（尤其是屯门公路）分流。全线最繁忙的路段是青衣西北交汇处附近的长青公路，机场、货柜码头和新界西北的车流在此共用道路。

en: The Western Harbour Crossing was the first three-lane-each-way immersed-tube tunnel in Asia. Its twelve units were cast in a basin at the Shek O quarry, alongside those for the Airport Railway's own harbour tube.

Ting Kau Bridge, 1,177 m long, was the world's first major four-span cable-stayed bridge. Its three towers each stand on a single leg and are steadied by transverse cables; the longest stays, at 465 m, were the longest used at the time. It was designed with Schlaich Bergermann and built from 1995 to 1998.

North of the bridge, the Tai Lam Tunnel takes the road 3.8 km under Tai Lam Country Park in twin three-lane bores. The Tsing Long Highway beyond it includes Hong Kong's first wildlife underpass, and north of the toll plaza its speed limit is 100 km/h.
zh: 西区海底隧道是亚洲第一条双程三线的沉管隧道。十二节沉管在石澳石矿场的铸造坞内铸造，与机场铁路的过海沉管同场铸造。
汀九桥全长 1,177 米，是世界上第一座大型四跨斜拉桥。三座桥塔各为单柱，以横向拉索稳定；最长的拉索长 465 米，为当时所用最长。大桥由施莱希·贝格曼参与设计，1995 至 1998 年建成。
过桥后，大榄隧道以双管三线在大榄郊野公园下穿行 3.8 公里。其后的青朗公路设有香港第一条野生动物地下通道，收费广场以北路段限速每小时 100 公里。

en: The road was first studied in 1986 as "Route X", a new corridor between the urban area and the north-west New Territories, and was given the number 3 in mid-1988. When the government chose Chek Lap Kok for the new airport, the route became one of the Airport Core Programme's roads; a HK$120 million design consultancy was let in August 1991 and construction began in 1993. It is the only route of the second numbering system whose number was carried over unchanged in 2004.

It opened in stages. The West Kowloon Highway and the Kwai Chung section of the Tsing Kwai Highway opened in February 1997, the Western Harbour Crossing on 30 April 1997, opened by Chief Secretary Anson Chan, and the Tsing Yi section with the Cheung Tsing Highway that May. The northern half — Ting Kau Bridge, the Tai Lam Tunnel and the Tsing Long Highway — opened on 25 May 1998, in time for the new airport.
zh: 这条道路于 1986 年以“X 干线”之名开始研究，作为市区与新界西北之间的新走廊，1988 年中获编为 3号。政府选定赤鱲角兴建新机场后，此路成为机场核心计划的道路之一；1991 年 8 月批出价值 1.2 亿港元的设计顾问合约，1993 年动工。它是第二代编号系统中唯一在 2004 年全线沿用原编号的干线。
它分段通车：西九龙公路及青葵公路葵涌段于 1997 年 2 月通车；西区海底隧道于 1997 年 4 月 30 日由布政司陈方安生主持通车；青衣段及长青公路于同年 5 月通车。北半段——汀九桥、大榄隧道及青朗公路——于 1998 年 5 月 25 日通车，赶及新机场启用。

en: Route 3 was paid for in two ways. The government built the middle — the West Kowloon Highway, Tsing Kwai Highway, Cheung Tsing Tunnel, Cheung Tsing Highway and Ting Kau Bridge — as Airport Core Programme works. The two ends were build–operate–transfer franchises of 30 years: the Western Harbour Crossing, built by the Western Harbour Tunnel Company (Cross-Harbour (Holdings) 50%, CITIC 35%, Kerry 15%), and the Tai Lam Tunnel with the Yuen Long approach, built by Route 3 (Country Park Section) Ltd.

The Western Harbour Crossing was estimated at HK$4.5 billion in 1989 and is put at HK$7 billion or HK$7.5 billion on completion. Its tolls were the highest of the three harbour crossings: HK$30 for a car at opening, rising to HK$75 by 2019. When the franchise ended on 2 August 2023 the government cut the car toll to HK$60. The Tai Lam Tunnel franchise ended on 31 May 2025, and the government cut its tolls by between 22% and 80%.
zh: 3号干线的资金来源分两种。中段——西九龙公路、青葵公路、长青隧道、长青公路及汀九桥——由政府作为机场核心计划工程兴建。两端则以 30 年“建造、营运、移交”专营权兴建：西区海底隧道由西区海底隧道有限公司（港通控股 50%、中信 35%、嘉里 15%）兴建；大榄隧道连元朗引道由三号干线（郊野公园段）有限公司兴建。
西区海底隧道 1989 年估算造价为 45 亿港元，建成后的造价有 70 亿与 75 亿港元两种说法。它的收费是三条过海隧道中最高的：通车时私家车 30 元，到 2019 年已升至 75 元。2023 年 8 月 2 日专营权届满后，政府把私家车收费降至 60 元。大榄隧道专营权于 2025 年 5 月 31 日届满，政府随即把收费下调 22% 至 80%。

en: Heading north, the Tsing Kwai and Cheung Tsing sections are urban expressway on viaduct and in tunnel; after Ting Kau Bridge and the Tai Lam Tunnel the road opens out through the hills to Kam Tin.
zh: 北行时，青葵及长青段是高架和隧道中的市区快速公路；过了汀九桥和大榄隧道后，道路在山间展开，直至锦田。

why.en: No total is published for the route: the government sections were costed within the Airport Core Programme (HK$160.2 billion for the whole programme) and the tunnels by their franchisees. Individual costs are listed below.
why.zh: 整条路线没有公布总造价：政府路段计入机场核心计划（整个计划 1,602 亿港元），隧道则由专营公司各自承担。各段造价分列如下。

value.en: Mixed: the Western Harbour Crossing (1993–2023) and the Tai Lam Tunnel with its Yuen Long approach (1995–2025) were private build–operate–transfer franchises; the sections between them were government-funded Airport Core Programme works
value.zh: 混合模式：西区海底隧道（1993—2023 年）及大榄隧道连元朗引道（1995—2025 年）为私人“建造、营运、移交”专营项目；两者之间的路段为政府出资的机场核心计划工程

timeline.en: A new north-west corridor, "Route X", is first studied.
timeline.zh: 新界西北新走廊“X 干线”开始研究。

timeline.en: Route X is assigned the number 3.
timeline.zh: X 干线获编为 3号干线。

timeline.en: A HK$120 million design consultancy is awarded in August.
timeline.zh: 8 月，批出 1.2 亿港元设计顾问合约。

timeline.en: Construction begins; the Western Harbour Crossing franchise is granted.
timeline.zh: 工程动工；西区海底隧道专营权批出。

timeline.en: Work starts on the Tai Lam Tunnel (13 March) and Ting Kau Bridge.
timeline.zh: 大榄隧道（3 月 13 日）及汀九桥动工。

timeline.en: The West Kowloon and Tsing Kwai highways open in February, the Western Harbour Crossing on 30 April, and the Tsing Yi section in May.
timeline.zh: 2 月西九龙公路及青葵公路通车，4 月 30 日西区海底隧道通车，5 月青衣段通车。

timeline.en: Ting Kau Bridge, the Tai Lam Tunnel and the Tsing Long Highway open on 25 May, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 5 月 25 日，汀九桥、大榄隧道及青朗公路通车，全线贯通。

timeline.en: The number 3 is kept in the third numbering system.
timeline.zh: 第三代编号系统沿用 3号。

timeline.en: The Western Harbour Crossing franchise ends on 2 August; the car toll is cut to HK$60.
timeline.zh: 8 月 2 日，西区海底隧道专营权届满，私家车收费降至 60 元。

timeline.en: The Tai Lam Tunnel passes to the government on 31 May, with lower tolls.
timeline.zh: 5 月 31 日，大榄隧道交还政府，收费下调。
